## Pull request checklist

- [ ] Scope is limited and I understand what this PR changes
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated
- [ ] `make check` passes in `project/`
- [ ] Formal assumptions are documented where they matter
- [ ] No private, secret, or collaborative-only material entered `project/`
- [ ] I can explain the implementation (including any AI-assisted parts)
- [ ] AI-generated material was reviewed and not accepted blindly
